notes.title: Achievment Update & Summer Sale
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Salesmen![/h1]

Sacrifice For Sale is currently at a 20% dicount once more!
And to mark the occasion we are releasing a brand-new quality of life feature:

[h2]In-game Achievments![/h2]
We noticed that some of the most fun players have with our game is attempting to hunt down some of the weird and fun achievements we laid out. So we made it easier and more accessible for you to start your achievment hunt and to embrace your inner completionist.

Now there is a new menu, in which you can see all of the achievments you have and dont have collected.
We also added a new in-game achievment notification, but don't worry, if you find it too intrusive you can turn it off in the options. (See, we thought of everything! =D)

So get out there and get those achievments!

And be sure to enjoy the Summer, your favourite two cultists are already enjoying the lovely weather!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869276/b248badd31c9981ca070fb46c731ada90a8b33c3.png[/img]

notes.title: Delay
notes.content:
[h1]Delayed Game[/h1]
Greetings, Salesmen!

This is awkward..... Remember how we said we would release today?
We [b]LIED[/b]!!!
Well, uhh... unintentionally anyway.
Unfortunately we aren't releasing today, and really we should have said so, much sooner, but you know how great we are with announcing things...

As it stands we just don't feel like the game is quite ready yet.
While we have been making very good progress. (Check out our [url=https://twitter.com/TeamIotaGames]twitter[/url] for more on that)
There is a certain amount of polish that is still missing from the game, that we want to ensure it has.

As such the game is not releasing as planned today.

[h1]New Release Date[/h1]
We have a new release date that we will definitely be releasing on for [i]realsies[/i] this time.
Mark [b]May 24th[/b] on you Calendar, 'cause on that day [b]Sacrifice For Sale[/b] will be on Steam!

[h1]Our Discord[/h1]
If you or a loved one has been affected by this delay, then please join our [url=https://discord.gg/gneCWgvU4D]discord[/url].
We have been thinking of ways to make it up to you guys for delaying and will be putting those into action over there.

We already implemented the brand new eldritch yellow role in our discord for you all to enjoy!
Join our [url=https://discord.gg/gneCWgvU4D]discord[/url] and stay tuned.

[h1]Q&A[/h1]
In an attempt to calm the rioting masses, we will be hosting a Q&A on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/teamiotagames]twitch[/url] today during our previously planned release time, at 4 PM GMT +0, so stay tuned for that.

Follow Sacrifice For Sale to be notified for the next announcement.
(There is a Follow button right beneath our trailer.
Yeah, I didn't know that feature exists either.)

And follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/TeamIotaGames]twitter[/url] to stay up to date with any new developments.
